mezz_config_gui.config.screen.title: MezzConfig GUI Options
mezz_config_gui.config.appearance.descri: Controls the size and layout mode of MezzConfig GUI screens.
mezz_config_gui.config.appearance.guiMod: Choose between a centered window and the full game window.
Use the configured window width and height.
Use the full game window for config screens.
mezz_config_gui.config.appearance.enable: Allow config screens, including the Mods screen, to be resized by dragging an edge or corner.
mezz_config_gui.config.appearance.window: Width of windowed config screens. Dragging a screen edge updates this value.
Height of windowed config screens. Dragging a screen edge updates this value.
mezz_config_gui.config.appearance.naviga: Preferred width of the category and section column. Drag the divider beside it to adjust this value. Narrow windows temporarily limit the width to leave room for config values.
mezz_config_gui.config.valueDisplay.desc: Controls how config values and their rows are presented.
mezz_config_gui.config.valueDisplay.rowD: Controls the amount of vertical spacing used by config value rows.
mezz_config_gui.config.valueDisplay.numb: Choose how bounded number values are displayed on config screens.
Use Minecraft-style slider bars for bounded integer and decimal values.
Use editable text and stepper buttons for bounded numbers.
mezz_config_gui.config.valueDisplay.show: Alternate value row backgrounds between slightly lighter and darker colors.
mezz_config_gui.config.navigation.descri: Controls search, category navigation, and scrolling behavior.
mezz_config_gui.config.navigation.inline: Show subsections with this many options or fewer as titled groups in their parent's value pane. Larger subsections and subsections with children keep their own navigation rows. Set to 0 to keep every subsection in navigation. Applies when opening a config screen.
mezz_config_gui.config.navigation.rememb: Return to the last selected category for each mod during this game session.
mezz_config_gui.config.navigation.search: Include config value descriptions when filtering search results.
mezz_config_gui.config.navigation.focusS: Put keyboard focus in the search box when a config screen opens.
mezz_config_gui.config.navigation.smooth: Animate scroll position changes instead of jumping immediately.
mezz_config_gui.config.navigation.scroll: Controls how far the config screen scrolls for each mouse wheel step.
mezz_config_gui.config.navigation.dragAu: Controls how quickly list rows auto-scroll while dragging near the edge.
mezz_config_gui.config.editing.descripti: Controls how edits are confirmed and how list values can be reordered.
mezz_config_gui.config.editing.confirmPe: Ask whether to save or discard pending changes when closing a config screen.
mezz_config_gui.config.editing.enableDra: Allow list rows to be reordered by dragging. Up and down buttons still work when this is disabled.
mezz_config_gui.config.modList.descripti: Choose the order and visibility of mods in the tab strip and Browse Configs list.
Mod IDs to show first, in the order listed. Other mods follow alphabetically. Unknown IDs and repeated IDs are ignored. Save and reopen a config screen to update the tabs.
mezz_config_gui.config.modList.hiddenMod: Mod IDs to hide from the tab strip and Browse Configs list. This only hides navigation entries; it does not disable mods or prevent other ways of opening their settings. Save and reopen a config screen to update the tabs.
mezz_config_gui.config.integrations.desc: Controls integration behavior with Minecraft and platform-specific config systems.
mezz_config_gui.config.integrations.show: Automatically add a mod's key mappings to its config screen when possible.
Show conflict highlighting and conflict details for key mappings.
mezz_config_gui.config.integrations.enab: Automatically create config screens for supported platform-native config files.
mezz_config_gui.config.advanced.descript: Controls the extra details and logging used to troubleshoot config screens.
mezz_config_gui.config.advanced.showAdva: Show stable names, apply mode, restart flags, serializers, and editor ids in value info.
mezz_config_gui.config.advanced.discover: Controls extra logging for config screen and plugin discovery.
Do not log extra discovery details.
Use normal warning and error logging.
